text:
Alex Romero: Heads up — bring-up for HF->Redwood import of saffron-7b is flapping. We only shipped tokenizer.json, no tokenizer_config.json. Loader picked the fast tokenizer but a bunch of special tokens (e.g. <|bos|>, role tokens) are missing from the mapping, so chat templates get mangled and evals regress.
Marie Chen: can you paste the loader debug and a tiny reproducer?
Alex Romero: here's the relevant debug when running local loader (condensed):
```
2026-03-18 09:12:03 INFO loader: found tokenizer.json at /artifacts/saffron-7b/tokenizer.json -> using fast tokenizers.FastTokenizer
2026-03-18 09:12:03 WARN loader: tokenizer_config.json not found, continuing with defaults
2026-03-18 09:12:03 DEBUG tokenizer: special_tokens_map: {}
2026-03-18 09:12:03 ERROR chat_template: role tokens absent, falling back to positional roles (will break evals)
```
Alex Romero: quick repro (python):
```python
from redwood.tokenizers import load_tokenizer
T = load_tokenizer('/artifacts/saffron-7b')
print(T.special_tokens)  # prints {}
```
Kevin Patel: ugh. We should prefer tokenizer_config.json when present and treat tokenizer.json-only imports as incomplete. Fast (rust) tokenizers can serialize tokenizer.json without the HF tokenizer_config wrapper, which loses our project-specific special tokens mapping.
Kevin Patel: quick option: if special_tokens_map empty, try to load slow tokenizer (from vocab/.json + merges) or look for a sidecar file called specials.json before accepting fast one.
Lucy Park: saw this hit in the quantized canary too — 6% worse on the chat QA eval (turn-level F1/Rouge). Canary rollback triggered. Might be why some prod chat sessions had stray role tokens.
infra-bot: artifacts-uploader: uploaded saffron-7b/tokenizer.json (size 2.1MB) to s3://redwood-artifacts/saffron-7b/ at 2026-03-18T09:10:55Z
Marie Chen: can you run the eval harness with and without the fix? small numbers are useful.
Alex Romero: ran quick local evals. baseline (fast-only):
- chatty-qual v1 (200 prompts): avg perplexity 18.3, turn-F1 0.72
After copying tokenizer_config.json (from HF original) into the artifact and reloading:
- chatty-qual v1: avg perplexity 16.9, turn-F1 0.78
Alex Romero: PR up to patch this (adds a fallback loader check and a validation step that fails artifact publish if specials are missing): https://github.com/redwood-inference/s3-artifacts/pull/3421
Kevin Patel: I'll take the loader change in runtime. Plan: detect empty special tokens -> attempt to load slow tokenizer or parse extras/specials.json -> if still missing, emit publish failure and block canary. Keeps production safe.
Marie Chen: re: model onboarding checklist, add a step: 'confirm special tokens present in artifact (tokenizer_config.json or specials.json)'. I'll update onboarding doc.
Lucy Park: can we also add a lightweight regression gate in the eval harness for chat templates (role token presence + 1-turn sanity)? Saves ops from rolling back.
Kevin Patel: yep, will add a quick probe that generates a 3-turn template and asserts that role tokens map to expected ids.
Alex Romero: thanks all. I'll re-run the full eval tomorrow after Kevin's runtime change. For now, I've pinned saffron-7b to the previous artifact and disabled canary.
Marie Chen: good call. @Kevin @Lucy annotate the PR with test cases please.
Kevin Patel: on it, PR comment incoming.
Alex Romero: awesome — big :thumbsup:  will follow up in #eng-releases once canary schedule is ready.
